Team —

We are in late-stage talks with Victory Bank (Karl Jensen, Head of Data Products). They’re greenlit a 6‑week POC for retail fraud scoring and want to speak to 1–2 customers with a similar profile (regional bank, ~3–6M retail accounts, US East) who have run a proof of concept and can speak to latency/throughput under peak windows and how Redwood integrated into their pipeline.

Key asks:
- Two 25–30 min reference calls next week (Apr 4–6) — one technical (infra/latency) + one product/ops (integration + rollout risks).
- Prefer customers who ran an on‑prem or dedicated deployment and used batching/KV caching.

I attached a one-pager with the ask. If you can recommend advocates, please list availability and whether we should lead outreach or loop in the AE to intro. Deal ID: RDW-4521 — HubSpot link below.

Thanks — I’d like to pull this together by EOD today so Karl has options.

Two quick candidates that fit the bill:

2) Daniel Ortiz — HorizonPay (payments platform) did a similar POC for fraud prevention; smaller footprint but had interesting batching/latency tuning work.

Both have been open to calls — I can intro to Priya directly (she’s on my reference roster). For Daniel I’ll check availability; his windows are tighter (PDT mornings).
